definitions: Happening at the exact moment it is relevant or expected, often coincidentally.
Appearing or occurring precisely when anticipated or needed, as if prompted.
examples: We were just talking about him, and as if on cue, he walked through the door.
The rain started, as if on cue, just as we finished setting up the tent.
I needed a pen, and as if on cue, one rolled off the desk right to my feet.
